---
title: "wrapped fixture: gt and flextable tables in Word"
filters:
  - wrapped
format: docx
echo: false
---

This fixture is not in `tests/verify.py`, because the CI setup installs
knitr and rmarkdown only. It needs the R packages gt and flextable. Render
it by hand from `tests/` with `quarto render docx-raw-tables.qmd`, then
make a PDF in LibreOffice (`soffice --headless --convert-to pdf`) and in
Word (`word-pdf.applescript`) to see each table beside its paragraph.

```{r}
#| label: tbl-gt
#| tbl-cap: A gt table.
#| classes: wrap-right
gt::gt(head(mtcars[, 1:4], 3))
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-flex
#| tbl-cap: A flextable with a wider first column and a merged header.
#| classes: .wrap-left
ft <- flextable::flextable(head(mtcars[, 1:4], 3))
ft <- flextable::add_header_row(ft, values = c("a", "b"), colwidths = c(2, 2))
flextable::width(ft, j = 1, width = 2)
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-flex-auto
#| tbl-cap: An autofit flextable.
#| classes: .wrap-right
ft <- flextable::flextable(head(mtcars[, 1:4], 3))
flextable::set_table_properties(ft, layout = "autofit", width = 1)
```
